evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free).
